title: 8/5/26: Severe Flash Flood Warning - Mainly Clear and 82.8, with a High of 86.2 and Low of 70.2 Tonight. - NewsBreak
text:
By Source Staff ,
5 hours ago Flash Flood Warning
Source: NWS
Severe Flash Flood Warning is in effect until further notice for Maury County.
At 5:45 PM, the temperature in Maury County is 82.8°F with a light wind from the east at 5 mph. There has been no recorded precipitation today, and the sky is mainly clear.
Earlier today, temperatures peaked at 86.2°F and dipped to a low of 70.2°F. Looking ahead to tonight, the temperature is expected to fall to around 74.7°F with winds calming to 4.5 mph. The sky is anticipated to remain clear with a low chance of precipitation at 11%.
Please remain cautious due to the active Severe Flash Flood Warning, as conditions may change rapidly. Stay tuned for updates and monitor local advisories.
